limits: Shared host, 3 calls; canonical public and direct-backend contract evidence, not a controlled speedup study.
Rust has no standalone MI or nearest-neighbor FFI; canonical gate records its supported contracts separately.

All owners now bin each MI window over its own range with NumPy histogram2d edges and select the first minimum of the sequentially summed squared distance; Mojo distances may differ from the reference in the last bit through fused multiply-add contraction.
reproduction: from benchmarks.embedding_benchmark import benchmark_embedding_polyglot_parity_gate; [benchmark_embedding_polyglot_parity_gate(n=n,calls=3) for n in [64,160]]
